sourceCommitNote: Repository HEAD at start; file hashes identify the runtime and working-tree analysis actually executed.
quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; the median averages the two central values for even sample sizes.
method: Deterministic navigation bot from tests/journey-bot.mjs with optional profile input, no-pulse, actual beacon-directed stationary policies and read-only observers. Uses real movement, collections, lamp costs, enemies and exits; no teleporting, health edits or boss bypasses.
limits: Bots know world positions and use pathfinding; they are not human players.
Simulation times exclude UI reading, shopping decisions and render costs.
Bot success rates do not estimate human win rates.
time includes right-censored 1200-second policy timeouts; winTime includes successful journeys only.
Final HP includes recovery effects and is not a stand-alone measure of combat pressure.
firstRunStamps is estimated only for fresh-profile terminal runs; maximal-profile and incomplete probes leave it blank.
camp_120s is an incomplete one-beacon farming probe; it is not counted as a completed journey.
Maximal is a configured all-talents-level-3 profile with a discovered prism-lamp heirloom; no live player data is used.
